description: An account with no models list refuses a model its provider's catalog does not have, without calling the upstream.

exceptions.reason: The old core answers an unknown model with 400 (unknown provider); the new core answers 404, as for any model no account serves.
For an unknown model the old core says unknown provider (invalid_request_error); the new core says no account serves the model, as Anthropic's not_found_error.
